_note: Battle backdrops by the enemy met there: assets/bg/at_<enemy>-gemini.png, 1920x1080. The first enemy of the fight that has a place decides.
at_grey_wolf: a wolf den in a black spruce forest at night: a dark hollow under the roots of a fallen giant spruce, gnawed bones and tufts of fur on trampled snow-dusted ground, moonlight through the trunks.
at_kikimora: a crooked moss-grown log hut on chicken-bone stilts at the edge of a forest bog at night, tangled yarn and spindles hanging from its eaves, a dim green light in the tiny window.
at_lesavka: a deep mossy thicket in an old forest: giant ferns, rings of pale mushrooms, fallen trunks covered in moss as thick as fur, green-gold twilight.
at_auka: a foggy forest crossroads where four narrow paths meet and bend back on themselves, old signposts with carved faces pointing every way, thick mist between black trunks.
at_mushroom_corpse: a rotten grove where huge pale shelf mushrooms and tall toadstools grow over fallen trunks and old grave mounds, spores drifting in sickly yellow light.
at_raven: a bare hill with one huge dead oak crowded with ravens' nests, feathers and small bones scattered on the ground, a grey dawn sky.
at_shishiga: the reed-choked bank of a slow black forest stream at dusk, a half-sunken rotten boat, snags and duckweed, mist over the water.
at_likho: the burned-out ruin of a lonely forest smithy at night: charred beams, a cold cracked forge, a single anvil, crooked black trees leaning in.
at_shatun: the mouth of a bear's den under a rocky outcrop in a snowy winter forest, tree trunks all around raked with deep claw marks, broken young pines, grey daylight.
at_poloz: a rocky forest ravine at night with veins of dull gold in the stone and many round snake holes in the walls, shed snakeskins on the gravel floor.
at_leshy: the heart of the oldest forest: colossal ancient trees like pillars, a wide mossy clearing with a throne formed from one enormous living stump, antlers and offerings hung on the branches, green cathedral light from above.
at_upyr: a neglected village graveyard at dusk: leaning wooden crosses with little roofs, several graves broken open from below, a rotted fence, sickly yellow light.
at_drowned_maiden: a black mill pond at night with a ruined watermill, its broken wheel half under water, willows trailing in the pond, pale water lilies, moonlight on the surface.
at_igosha: the inside of an abandoned peasant hut at night: a cold clay stove, an overturned cradle, a table with dust and broken bowls, moonlight through a small window onto the plank floor.
at_anchutka: a low black log bathhouse on stilts at the edge of a swamp at night, steam leaking from under its door, a slippery plank walkway, hoof prints in the mud.
at_swamp_light: an open bog at night crossed by a single rotten plank path, dozens of pale will-o'-the-wisps hanging over black pools, dead birches, distant fog.
at_tinyak: the bed of a drained village pond: cracked grey slime, rotting reeds, a stranded boat and fish bones, green haze, dead willows on the banks.
at_yrka: a night field at the edge of a dead village with crooked scarecrows on poles stretching away into darkness, stubble on the ground, a low red moon.
at_vurdalak_elder: the yard of the village headman's big carved log house at dusk: a tall porch with carved pillars, a long feast table set outside with overturned benches, dark stains on the boards, torches burning low.
at_poludnitsa: a vast scorched rye field at blazing white noon, heat shimmer, the sun directly overhead in a bleached sky, a lone dead tree and a dropped sickle, cracked dry ground.
at_tryasovitsa: a plague-struck village street at dusk: log huts with doors marked by tarred crosses, smoky juniper fires burning in the road, rags on poles, sickly yellow haze.
at_bolotnik: the deep heart of a great swamp at night: a huge ancient wooden idol sunk to its shoulders in black water, islands of moss, drowned trees, green marsh gas glowing low over the pools.
at_nav_soul: the grey shore of the black river Smorodina in the underworld, small pale lights drifting over the water like souls, ash-coloured sand, a sky hanging upside down.
at_kostomakha: an endless field of bones in the underworld: heaped skulls and ribs, a few standing spears, cold blue fog, quiet snow falling upward.
at_mavka: a frozen birch grove in the underworld whose trees grow downward from the sky as well as up from the ground, hoarfrost on every twig, dead white light.
at_koschei_guard: the iron gate of Koschei's keep: a towering black wall of riveted iron and bone, rows of empty helmets on stakes, a road of grey flagstones, cold blue light.
at_volot: the ruins of the giants: enormous broken stone steps and toppled columns far too large for men, half buried in grey ash, a dim cold sun.
at_weeper: a plain of veiled stone women in the underworld: dozens of weathered statues with covered faces standing in rows, ice running down them like tears, pale mist.
at_raven_upyr: a stand of dead black trees in the underworld hung with iron cages and gibbets, torn black feathers on the frozen ground, a dull red glow on the horizon.
at_sirin: the crown of a gigantic dead tree above a sea of clouds at night, a huge nest woven of branches and bones on a broad bough that serves as the ground, cold stars.
at_black_rider: the red-hot iron Kalinov bridge over the burning black river Smorodina seen along its length, glowing chains, smoke and sparks rising, darkness on the far side.
at_volot_giant: a mountain pass in the underworld formed by the colossal skeleton of a fallen giant, its ribs arching overhead like a hall, snow on the ground between them.
at_mara: the hall of winter: a vast cavern of blue ice with a throne of icicles on a dais, frozen figures of warriors standing along the walls, frost flowers on the floor, dead white light.
at_koschei: Koschei's throne hall: a huge dark vault with heaps of tarnished gold and bones, a high black throne of iron and skulls, and beside it a great dead oak growing through the floor with an iron-bound chest chained in its branches, cold green candlelight.
